items.title: File Einspruch against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Frist: zwei Wochen nach dem Tag der Zustellung.
items.computation: The attached Zustellungsurkunde (formal delivery certificate, § 182 ZPO) shows 'zugestellt am 19.09.2025' (Friday) - this printed date is the delivery day, no days are added for formal delivery. Per §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB (via § 43 StPO), the day of delivery itself is not counted; the two-week period ends on the same weekday two weeks later, i.e. 19.09.2025 + 14 days = 03.10.2025 (Friday). 03.10 is Tag der Deutschen Einheit, a nationwide public holiday, so under § 43 Abs. 2 StPO / § 193 BGB the period end moves to the next working day. 04.10 is a Saturday and 05.10 is a Sunday, so the deadline moves to Monday 06.10.2025.

items.title: Pay total fine amount (Geldbuße, Gebühr, Auslagen)
items.quote: Zahlung: Gesamtbetrag binnen zwei Wochen ab Rechtskraft auf das unten angegebene Konto (Verwendungszweck: Aktenzeichen).
items.computation: Payment is due two weeks after Rechtskraft (the decision becoming final), not from the notice date. Assuming no Einspruch is filed, Rechtskraft occurs on the day after the Einspruch period ends, i.e. the day after 06.10.2025 = 07.10.2025 (Tuesday). Per §§ 187, 188 BGB the day of Rechtskraft is not counted; two weeks later on the same weekday = 21.10.2025 (Tuesday), which is not a weekend day or public holiday, so it stands. This date is contingent on no Einspruch being filed and is only an estimate of when Rechtskraft occurs.

warnings: Several sender and party details (Zentrale Bußgeldstelle 'Musterland', place name 'Neu-Musterdorf', 'Musterbank') use the German word 'Muster' (template/sample), which strongly suggests this is a template or specimen document rather than a genuine notice from a real authority - verify the sender's authenticity before paying or relying on the deadlines.

The payment due date (2025-10-21) is an estimate based on the assumption that no Einspruch is filed and that Rechtskraft occurs the day after the Einspruch deadline; if an Einspruch is filed, the payment obligation does not arise on this schedule.
